refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.subtitle: Clear, fair, and enforceable, for digital products and consulting services.

headline.title: Our policy in one line
headline.body: Refunds are available within 14 days of purchase, provided the digital product has not been downloaded. Once any file from an order is downloaded, that item becomes non-refundable.

eligible.title: Refunds Are Available When
items: The request is made within 14 days of the original purchase date.
No file from the order has been downloaded yet (verified via download logs).
A duplicate charge was made due to a payment processing error.
The digital product is materially different from its public description, or a defect prevents normal use and our team cannot resolve it within 48 hours.
A consulting service was not delivered as outlined in the signed service agreement.

ineligible.title: Refunds Are Not Available When
items: Any file from the order has been downloaded. Once accessed, the digital product is considered consumed.
The request is made more than 14 days after the original purchase date.
A change of mind after the product was downloaded, viewed, or used.
Incompatibility with third-party software, devices, or environments not specified in the product description.
Consulting hours that have already been delivered, or service packages that have been partially consumed.
Subscription renewals or recurring charges where the renewal notice was sent in advance.

steps.label: Open a support ticket
steps.descSuffix: with your order number and the reason. If you don't have an account, email

steps.label: Eligibility review
steps.desc: Our team checks the order against the policy above, including download logs, and replies within 3 business days.

steps.label: Decision
steps.desc: If approved, the refund is issued to the original payment method. If declined, you receive a written explanation referencing the policy section that applies.

steps.label: Funds returned
steps.desc: Approved refunds settle on your original payment method (PayPal or MercadoPago) within 5–10 business days. Bank timelines may extend this.

steps.label: Access revoked
steps.desc: On any approved refund, whether partial or full, download access for the refunded items is immediately revoked. Existing downloaded copies must be deleted by the customer.

chargebacks.title: Before disputing a charge with your bank
chargebacks.body: We resolve every legitimate refund request directly. Initiating a chargeback before contacting us delays resolution and incurs processor fees on both sides. Please reach out first; we respond within 3 business days. In the event of a chargeback, we provide payment processors with our policy, your acceptance at checkout, and the full download log as evidence.

spanishSummary.title: Resumen en español (México · PROFECO)
spanishSummary.body: De acuerdo con el Artículo 56 de la Ley Federal de Protección al Consumidor, el consumidor cuenta con cinco días hábiles para revocar una compra a distancia, siempre que el producto digital no haya sido descargado o consumido. Una vez descargado, el producto se considera entregado y consumido, por lo que no procede el reembolso. Para servicios de consultoría parcialmente entregados, el reembolso se calcula sobre las horas no consumidas. Las solicitudes deben dirigirse a {{email}} dentro de los 14 días posteriores a la compra.
